scope: Read-only artifact integrity, visual readability, and video validity. No numerical evaluation rerun.

visual_inspection.labels: Source/target RGB distinguished from coarse frozen-probe outputs; model seed, requested displacement, frame/tubelet, and no-generation qualification readable.
nonblocking_display_notes: The full position-error axis includes the wrong-direction control and therefore visually compresses differences among low-error methods. Exact numeric labels remain readable.
Summary whiskers show min/max seed means, not scene-bootstrap confidence intervals. This is explicitly labeled.
The summary chart has three original metrics and does not display the subsequently added coarse colour-identity result; consult evaluation tables for that result.
Predetermined videos show six panels and omit residual transport; each accompanying comparison PNG includes it.

evidence_limits: The fixed examples visually show the selected warm-colour blob displaced into the intended region, but this is a coarse readout of edited latents.
Local source-hole/background RGB artifacts and faint vacated-area occupancy responses remain visible in the fixed examples.
Even the genuine-target readout does not reproduce stripe/checkerboard detail. These visuals cannot establish detailed identity or texture preservation.
Source/target RGB panels are renderer ground truth, not video generated from edited features.
Two predetermined positive shifts illustrate the run; aggregate metrics cover all sixteen scenes and both signs.
Playback is eight frames per second for inspection; each probe output covers a two-frame tubelet.
